result.title: Which One Is Sounding? Binaural Sounding Instance Disambiguation for Audio-Visual Segmentation
result.summary: Existing audio-visual segmentation methods mainly predict sound-related regions or category masks and often fail to identify the sounding instance when multiple same-class candidates coexist. Recent audio-visual instance segmentation methods address instance-level prediction but rely largely on motion and cross-frame association, which may become unreliable under sparse observations or inconspicuous motion. To this end, we introduce binaural audio, whose interaural differences encode source-direction information, to provide spatial constraints for distinguishing the sounding instance among same-class visual candidates. We propose Binaural Sounding Instance Disambiguation for Audio-Visual Segmentation (BiSID-AVS), which progressively refines category-level candidate responses into a mask of the true sounding instance. BiSID-AVS first grounds category-consistent candidate regions through audio prompting, then projects binaural cues into an image-plane spatial response map, and finally refines the true sounding instance through dual-level spatial conditioning at the feature and decoder levels. Experiments on the binaurally extended AVS-Synthetic benchmark and Habitat-AVS dataset for robotic indoor perception show that BiSID-AVS achieves the best performance on the multi-candidate subsets, improving instance-level mIoU by 35.19 and 41.21 percentage points, respectively, while substantially reducing false activation on non-sounding same-class regions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 BiSID-AVS：先用音频提示定位同类候选区域，再把双耳音频的耳间差异投影为图像平面空间响应图，并在特征与解码器两级施加空间条件，从多个同类候选里挑出真正发声的实例。
AI.relevance_reason: 「先得候选、再用辅助空间线索筛选真正证据」的流程可能与 LVR 的视觉证据筛选相关，其线索到响应图的投影与双层条件化可供核查是否用于候选门控；但原文不做 latent 推理状态。
